Container.Name: MunchMaze
Container.Overview: Munch Maze is a self-hosted multiplayer maze-chase game that runs in any web browser. Everyone who enters the same seed shares one maze: players eat pellets together, dodge ghosts, and clear the level to unlock the next one, which is bigger. Levels are generated from the seed, starting at a small 15x11 maze with one ghost and growing up to 63x51 with six. There is no player limit, no accounts and no external services. Open the Web UI, pick a name, and share the invite link.[br][br]High scores are kept in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port players open in their browser.

Config.Name: Show running mazes
Config.Description: List active seeds on the start screen (true/false). Turn off for private games.

Config.Name: Default seed
Config.Description: Seed used when a player leaves the seed blank. Empty gives everyone a random maze.

Config.Name: Max mazes
Config.Description: How many different seeds can run at once.

Config.Name: Max connections
Config.Description: Most players connected at once. 0 means no limit.

Config.Name: Max connections per IP
Config.Description: Most connections from one address. 0 means no limit.

Config.Name: Behind reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set true if players reach the game through a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik).

Config.Name: Test mode
Config.Description: Set true to give each maze host a menu beside the map that fires any power-up on demand (pause, slot lands on the pick, then it activates). Leave false for normal play: crates stay random.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address players use to reach the game, e.g. http://10.0.10.160:8080 or https://maze.example.com (no trailing slash). Needed for Discord login: add PUBLIC_URL/auth/discord/callback as a redirect in your Discord application.

Config.Name: Discord client ID
Config.Description: Optional. From your Discord application (OAuth2 page). With the secret below, players can log in with Discord to claim their name and keep their scores. Leave empty to turn logins off.

Config.Name: Discord client secret
Config.Description: Optional. Your Discord application's client secret (OAuth2 page). Kept on the server only.

Config.Name: Allowed origins
Config.Description: Other websites allowed to open game connections, comma-separated. Leave empty unless your proxy rewrites the Host header.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns the appdata files.
